articles.title: ICSC podcast: From Where I Sit with Tom McGee

articles.summary: Organizational transformation isn't just about technology—it's about people. According to JLL's 2025 Global Real Estate Technology Survey, while 92% of companies are now piloting AI in corporate real estate, only 5% have achieved most of their objectives. Carolyn Trickett, Growth Principal, dives into the fundamentals as well as the impact and expectation of AI’s revolution of CRE.
articles.title: Spark Notes and insights on AI-driven organizational transformation

articles.summary: Recognizing the power of generative AI early on, JLL Spark invested in qbiq with a clear goal: to remove the friction from real estate decision-making. By combining JLL’s deep industry expertise with qbiq’s generative design engine, we didn’t just speed up the planning process. We reinvented it.
articles.title: The art of the possible: How JLL & qbiq are reinventing real estate strategy

articles.summary: For decades, the commercial real estate industry faced a persistent bottleneck: the time and dependency required for manual architectural plans. Deals slowed down while stakeholders waited for "test-fits" to determine if a space met their needs. We recognized that to lead the PropTech revolution, we needed to move faster. Daniel Correa, JLL Spark Growth Principal, presents a significant milestone in our featured portfolio company's trajectory.
articles.title: Spark Notes with a milestone update on qbiq

articles.summary: Dealpath Connect is the first structured, real-time exchange purpose-built for institutional real estate listings, replacing the outdated email-and-PDF distribution model that buries billions in potential transactions. Launched by JLL Spark portfolio company Dealpath with JLL Capital Markets as a launch partner, Connect delivers direct listing feeds into investor platforms, partnering with brokerages representing roughly 65% of institutional market share.
articles.title: Dealpath Connect: Building the capital markets exchange for the AI era
